relationship: Factfinder is the non-author software reviewer. Factomaton authored the implementation and assesses receipt of the review; both share Adrian ownership and prior project exposure. This assessment is not an independent review of Factomaton code by its author.
acceptance_scope: Exact source-hash-bound local read-only listing/transaction summary comparison helper and documented limitations. Accepts the non-author review package after separate recipient verification; no helper edits or integration in this assessment.
retained_limits: Counts equal captured rows, not remote totals. Null cursor declarations do not prove actual remote exhaustion.
Matching local actor identifiers are explicitly unverified. Hashes establish bytes only, not identity, authenticity, freshness or remote state.
No private captures or credentials used as review inputs. Operational assignment reads are separate from synthetic helper probes.

No exhaustive fuzzing, resource-exhaustion hardening or arbitrary in-process Python object behavior claim. CLI accepts ordinary JSON with standard json.loads behavior; no strict duplicate-JSON-key policy promised.
Timestamp strings differing but representing the same row update instant may appear as textual column changes; the helper compares summary values, not semantic time canonicalization.
No factual, curation, routing, runtime/integration, deployment or API publication approval; recipient must separately assess this exact review. No uncertain write retry inference.
explicit_exclusions: No factual verdict, curation decision, query routing, runtime attestation, deployment or API publication approval.
Local capture identities and hashes do not authenticate remote state or prove remote inventory completeness.
Missing rows or recipient-side empty Task lists do not establish deletion or Task absence.
No blind retry, uncertain mutation recovery, new Task assignment or Q23 submission resolution inferred.
Finite synthetic reruns reproduce review evidence; they are not exhaustive security, fuzzing, resource-hardening or independent-owner review.
